svg.title: How KVCacheManager hands out and takes back KV blocks
svg.desc: Free KV blocks wait in free_block_queue, a doubly linked list. allocate_slots pops blocks from the front and records them in req_to_blocks. When a request frees its blocks, blocks without a hash go back to the front for quick reuse, and blocks with a hash go to the tail so that cached blocks are overwritten in LRU order. On a prefix cache hit, cached_block_hash_to_block finds the block and it is taken out of the middle of the queue.
